description: This file contains the minified source code for Bootstrap v4.0.0-beta, including core JavaScript components such as alerts, buttons, carousels, collapses, modals, scrollspy, tabs, tooltips, and popovers. It enforces dependencies, defines classes for each component, manages event handling, and provides jQuery interface integrations.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Handles the alert component, allowing dismissible alerts.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Handles toggle buttons and button groups.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: Updates navigation based on scroll position.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: Extends tooltip with more content and options.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances carousel to the next item.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous carousel item.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates component positions, used in scrollspy.

methods.name: dispose()
methods.description: Destroys component instance and cleans up.
